concept.title: Four Meals, One Bottle
concept.hook: Tight macro on a hand shaking the deep red bottle over a cast iron pan of fried eggs, overlay: Your eggs called.
concept.surpriseBeat: After four fast drizzles on the beat, the final spoon bite shows a calm face that slowly turns into a raised-eyebrow smile as the heat arrives a beat later.

locations.description: Lived-in home kitchen with butcher block counter and stovetop with a cast iron pan
locations.lighting: Warm natural window light with deep shadows

locations.description: Small dining table beside a sunny window
locations.lighting: Sunny side light, rich reds, soft film grain

scenes.action: A woman in a rolled-sleeve cream linen shirt shakes the bottle, then drizzles deep red sauce over two fried eggs in a cast iron pan.
scenes.framing: Tight macro-leaning food framing, bottle and eggs in frame
scenes.motion: Bottle tilts and shakes once, hand exits quickly, label stays facing camera
scenes.dialogue: Your eggs called. They want a better hot sauce.
scenes.sound: Pan sizzle, bottle shake, tight drum break begins

scenes.action: A man in an olive knit sweater finishes a taco with a quick red drizzle, then a rust-toned bowl of noodles gets the same, seen from above.
scenes.framing: Overhead on the counter, taco then noodle bowl, bottle edge entering the frame
scenes.motion: Bottle swings in and out, red lines land on the food
scenes.lighting: Soft natural light from the window
scenes.overlayText: Garlic. Fermented chile. A little fruit.
scenes.sound: Slap bass groove, muted guitar chicks, quick cuts on the beat

scenes.action: The woman in a heather tee under a dark apron drizzles a slice of pizza on the butcher block counter, and the man grins at the colour.
scenes.framing: Close on the pizza slice, bottle held above, faces soft in the background
scenes.motion: Slow lean in, sauce falls in a ribbon, both cooks relax
scenes.lighting: Warm golden light with rich reds
scenes.dialogue: Garlic, fermented chile, a little fruit.
scenes.sound: Soft kitchen ambience, funk groove continues

scenes.action: Slow-motion drizzle: sauce falls from the bottle tip in a thick strand onto a spoon at the table by the window, then the man lifts the spoon.
scenes.framing: Bottle tip and spoon, shallow depth of field, label facing camera
scenes.motion: Single slow drip stretches and lands, spoon steady
scenes.sound: Music dips to a low hum, soft drip sound

scenes.action: He takes a bite and looks calm for a beat, then raises an eyebrow and smiles. Cut to the bottle centered, label facing camera, for the final hold.
scenes.framing: Medium close on his face, then centered bottle on the table
scenes.motion: Face shifts from calm to a raised-eyebrow smile, bottle stays still
scenes.lighting: Warm window light, light film grain
scenes.overlayText: Heat that waits a second. Try the bottle.
scenes.dialogue: Heat that waits a second. Try the bottle.
scenes.sound: Short horn stab on the bottle shot, groove resolves

rubric.reason: Follows the brief's structure closely with strong food specificity and clear product use. The delayed-heat reaction is a quiet surprise rather than a big one.

concept.title: The Wait
concept.hook: Extreme close on a spoon with one red drip about to fall, overlay: Wait for it.
concept.surpriseBeat: The bite lands and nothing seems to happen, then the cook's raised-eyebrow smile arrives a full beat later, cut against a drum fill.

locations.description: Small dining table by a sunny window with a bowl and spoon
Home kitchen with butcher block counter and cast iron pan
locations.lighting: Warm window light with film grain

scenes.action: A drip of deep red sauce hangs from the bottle tip over a spoon, then falls.
scenes.framing: Macro on bottle tip and spoon, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: One slow drip falls, spoon held still by a bare forearm
scenes.lighting: Sunny side light, rich red tones
scenes.sound: Quiet room tone, one soft drip, bass note

scenes.action: In the kitchen, a woman in a rust knit sweater shakes the bottle and drizzles fried eggs in the cast iron pan.
scenes.framing: Tight on pan and bottle, label facing camera
scenes.motion: Quick shake, drizzle, hand leaves the frame
scenes.overlayText: Garlic. Fermented chile. A little fruit.
scenes.dialogue: Garlic, fermented chile, a little fruit.
scenes.sound: Sizzle, groove kicks in with drum break

scenes.action: A man in a charcoal tee and dark apron drizzles a taco on the butcher block counter, then a slice of pizza beside it.
scenes.framing: Side track along the counter at food height
scenes.motion: Camera slides past two plates as the bottle swings over each
scenes.sound: Slap bass, muted guitar chicks, cuts on the beat

scenes.action: At the table, the woman takes a spoonful from the noodle bowl and looks neutral and confident.
scenes.framing: Medium close on her face and spoon
scenes.motion: She chews calmly, eyes steady on camera
scenes.sound: Music thins out to just bass and a hi-hat

scenes.action: Her eyebrow rises and she smiles. Cut to the bottle centered on the table, label facing camera, held for the end.
scenes.framing: Face close, then centered bottle shot
scenes.motion: Eyebrow lift, smile; bottle stays still
scenes.lighting: Warm window light, light film grain
scenes.sound: Horn stab on the bottle, groove lands

rubric.reason: Opening on the drip creates curiosity and the whole ad builds to one clear delayed reaction. Product use is slightly lighter in the middle scenes.

concept.title: Cook's Quiet Confidence
concept.hook: Handheld close on a cook's hand setting the bottle down on a butcher block next to a pan of eggs, overlay: That's the whole secret.
concept.surpriseBeat: Two cooks reach for the same bottle at the table, and the one who gets it drizzles slowly while the other waits with a raised eyebrow.

locations.description: Lived-in kitchen with butcher block counter and stovetop with a cast iron pan
Small dining table by a sunny window
locations.lighting: Bright side light with deep shadows

scenes.action: A man in a rolled-sleeve olive linen shirt sets the bottle on the butcher block beside fried eggs in the pan.
scenes.framing: Close on the bottle and eggs, label facing camera
scenes.motion: Bottle set down and turned slightly, hand leaves the frame
scenes.dialogue: Garlic, fermented chile, a little fruit. That's the whole secret.

scenes.action: The woman shakes the bottle and drizzles a taco, then a slice of pizza, in two quick cuts.
scenes.framing: Tight food framing, bottle at the top of the frame
scenes.sound: Slap bass groove, guitar chicks, cuts on the beat

scenes.action: Overhead of a noodle bowl on the table as red sauce is drizzled across it in a zigzag.
scenes.framing: Straight down on the bowl, table edge visible
scenes.motion: Bottle passes across the bowl, then lifts out
scenes.sound: Funk groove continues, chopstick tap on the bowl

scenes.action: The two cooks sit at the table and both reach for the bottle. She gets it first and tips it over a spoon in slow motion.
scenes.framing: Two hands and the bottle tip, spoon below, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: One slow drip stretches and falls onto the spoon, the other hand waits

scenes.action: She takes the bite, then raises an eyebrow and smiles as the heat arrives. Cut to the bottle centered, label facing camera.
scenes.framing: Medium close on her face, then centered bottle
scenes.motion: Calm face, then eyebrow lift and smile; bottle still
scenes.lighting: Warm window light, light film grain
scenes.sound: Horn stab on the bottle shot, groove resolves

rubric.reason: Calm, confident tone fits the voice and the shared-bottle moment is a warm, relatable beat. The hook is gentler and the surprise is milder than the other concepts.
